newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mercosur a mystery to half of Brazil - poll.
newsitem.headline: Mercosur a mystery to half of Brazil - poll.

text.p: Half of Brazil's 160 million people know nothing about South America's four-nation Mercosur customs union to which they belong, according to a poll published Monday.

A survey by U.S. polling firm Gallup published by Gazeta Mercantil newspaper found that 20 percent of Brazilians had never even heard of Mercosur, which links the economies of Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay and Argentina.
The poll, which surveyed 611 people, said another 30 percent said they had heard the name Mercosur, but did not know what it meant.
"A large part of the population is not aware of Mercosur," Carlos Eduardo Matheus, director of the poll, told the newspaper.
Fifty percent of those surveyed said they knew about Mercosur. Some 32 percent of the total surveyed were said to "know it well." The poll gave no margin of error.

The survey also found that 35 percent of those polled said Brazil should increase trade with Europe, compared to 29 percent who thought the country should increase trade with the United States and 26 percent, with South America.
